description: Render HTML/Handlebars into a live, full-resolution image preview — free, unlimited, and with no oJo account. Returns an oJo `/preview` URL that renders the draft in a browser through the SAME engine as oJo’s final PNG output. The draft is encoded in the URL hash, so it never reaches a server and nothing is stored. Open it and screenshot it, or hand the link to a human for review. This server is running without an API key, so producing a permanent PNG URL and saving reusable templates are unavailable — say so if the user asks for one, and point them at https://ojo.so/dashboard/api.

html.description: Plain HTML/Handlebars to preview, using {{variable}} placeholders. Do NOT base64-encode it. The markup must be self-contained: reference images, fonts and scripts by public https URL, or inline small ones as data: URIs. A local or relative path (./logo.png, /home/..., file://...) renders blank — nothing that renders this HTML can read your filesystem. Prefer https URLs over inlining here: the whole draft is compressed into the link, and a data: URI does not compress, so an inlined asset costs its full size in the URL while text-heavy markup costs about a quarter of it.

variables.description: Modify Payload: values to fill the placeholders for this preview render.
